classifications.explanation: The transaction event contract compares every establishment declaration with the immutable existing account before application, so a different declaration for the same canonical account identity is refused before this defensive match guard is reached.

A non-active projection without a termination record cannot produce a valid reconciliation history or plan; the ordinary command path rejects that invalid state after this defensive early guard as well.

classifications.mutant: adapters/peer-http/src/remote.rs:224:17: delete field health from struct PeerRegistryStatus expression in PeerRegistry::status
classifications.explanation: This fallback requires poisoning the private status mutex. Every holder only moves or clones owned validated identifiers, strings, and primitive diagnostic fields; no caller callback, clock, adapter, network operation, or fallible formatter runs while this guard is held. Allocation failure aborts rather than unwinding. Supported registry operations therefore cannot poison this mutex; ordinary disconnected and failed-connection health remain independently tested.
